subject: Unannounced token-hydration safeguard — immediate activation requested
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: alice.park@nebulaai.com, tom.lewis@nebulaai.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2027 02:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unannounced token-hydration safeguard — immediate activation requested

Hi Alice / Tom,

We discovered a rapidly emerging token-hydration mismatch in our runtime that can cause marginally altered generations for very long-context calls. The team is seeing a small but reproducible divergence for sequences > 32k tokens when using the new KV prefetch path. This surfaced in internal smoke tests and a very small subset of customer traffic over the last hour.

To reduce risk while we stabilize the kernel selection, we are preparing to flip an emergency safeguard (a short-lived shim that forces conservative KV hydration) in the Nebula AI tenant routing for your account. This is an unscheduled change and will change the effective runtime behavior for some long-context requests — the tradeoff is reduced drift and improved determinism. Expected impact: brief (~30–90s) connection resets for in-flight streams and slightly higher per-token compute for affected requests while the shim is active.

Requested next steps from you:
- Please acknowledge receipt of this note and confirm if you want us to proceed immediately.
- After activation, run the attached smoke checks (smoke-test-instructions.pdf) and paste the first line of the smoke output back to this thread.

We will:
- Hold the change window to under 10 minutes for the initial activation.
- Keep the old path available as an automatic fallback.
- Produce activation logs (activation-log.txt) and a short post-activation summary within 2 hours.

If you are on-call and prefer us to wait for a scheduled maintenance window, we can delay — but given error budgets and some observed drift, our recommendation is immediate activation.

Apologies for the short notice; I know this is disruptive. We’ll follow up with a postmortem and remediation timeline.

— Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
[attachment: smoke-test-instructions.pdf (PDF)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2027 02:20:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Unannounced token-hydration safeguard — immediate activation requested

Chloe / Marissa —

We're ready to roll the safeguard. Ops will do a staged flip: 1) NebulaAI control plane routing only, 2) monitor for error spikes for 3 minutes, 3) widen if stable. I’m kicking off the change now and will post the activation log.

Technical notes for the record (ops):
- Toggle: runtime.keystore.hydration_mode = conservative_shim
- Fallback: runtime.keystore.hydration_mode = auto (automatic fallback if error rate > 5% over 60s)
- Expected CPU delta: +6–9% on affected pods

I’ll paste activation-log.txt when available.

— Ben
Ben Carter | On-call, Runtime Ops
[attachment: activation-log.txt (text)]

Alice / Tom —

Thanks for the quick confirmation and for running the checks. Summary/follow-up:

- Activation completed at 2027-07-09T02:21:42-07:00 for NebulaAI tenant routing.
- Initial smoke-check first-line result from your run: "SMOKE_OK: hydration_consistency=pass, latency_delta_ms=+12" — matches our observed outcome.
- No sustained error spike observed; the fallback did not trigger.
- Attached activation-log.txt includes the exact toggle and per-pod timestamps.

Next steps from Redwood:
1) We will keep the conservative shim in place for 48 hours while the kernel and prefetch regression are patched in a follow release.
2) We’ll run a coordinated test with NebulaAI engineering on Monday 2027-07-12 to validate the kernel update and confirm parity.
3) A postmortem with root cause and long-term mitigation will be delivered by 2027-07-11 18:00 PDT.

If anything looks off on your side, reply here and we’ll revert the shim immediately. Thanks again for the fast collaboration.

— Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
